For dense separated positions compare fine moments pN to fixed-level Vj,N, Cauchy by Confluence, with uniform error bounded by fixed cost over g(j) →∞. Choose j for error below ε/4, then the fixed-level tail for pairwise difference below ε/4, proving full-mesh Cauchy comparison. More generally eventual compact oscillation bounds and Cauchy values on a dense set imply local uniform convergence even for discontinuous approximants.
